mutation FlxAiSettingsUpdate($input: FlxAiSettingsUpdateInput!) {
  flxAiSettingsUpdate(input: $input) {
    settings {
      ...FlxAiSettingsFields
    }
    secrets {
      ...FlxAiSecretFields
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxAiSecretFields on FlxAiSecret {
  name
  group
  label
  help
  configured
  hint
  fromConfig
}

fragment FlxAiSettingsFields on FlxAiSettings {
  anthropicWorkspace
  model
  chatModel
  titleModel
  sourceModels {
    source
    label
    model
  }
  cache
  effort
  thinking
  limitDay
  limitWeek
  limitMonth
  limitAction
  limitWarnPct
  limitNotify
  chatRoles
  chatAdmin
  chatFront
  chatMode
  chatMaxRounds
  chatHistory
  chatInstructions
  chatWidgets
  mediaImageModel
  mediaVideoModel
  mediaDays
  imageToolOn
  webOn
  webFetchOn
  shellOn
  webProvider
  webSearchMonth
  webSearchCost
  renderUrl
  renderUser
  logDays
  logBodies
  logBodyDays
  deleteData
}

query FlxAiLogs($first: Int = 50, $after: String, $days: Int = 7, $kind: FlxAiLogKind, $source: String, $errorsOnly: Boolean = false) {
  flxAiLogs(
    first: $first
    after: $after
    days: $days
    kind: $kind
    source: $source
    errorsOnly: $errorsOnly
  ) {
    nodes {
      ...FlxAiLogRowFields
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      endCursor
    }
    totalCount
  }
  flxAiLogSources {
    id
    label
  }
}

fragment FlxAiLogRowFields on FlxAiLog {
  databaseId
  time {
    timestamp
    label
  }
  kind

  chatId
  userId
  userName
  provider
  model
  modelLabel
  tool
  inTokens
  outTokens
  cacheRead
  cacheWrite
  cost
  estimated
  ms
  ok
  error
  errorLabel
  hasBody
}
